entities.summary: Andrea Bruno Mazzocato is an Italian Catholic prelate. He was ordained to the priesthood in 1972. From 2000 to 2003 he was bishop of Adria-Rovigo and from 2003 until 2009 served as the Bishop of Treviso. In 2009, Mazzocato became the Archbishop of Udine.
